why: Jack 25 Oct: the MFS host as BadCode in person, logo for a face, no skin
prompt: A photograph from a made-up television show: a presenter who might be a man or might be a machine, standing chest-up and square to the camera in front of a huge wall screen. His whole head is covered by a close-fitting white knitted balaclava with no mouth hole. One eye opening is sewn shut with white wool; over the other eye is a flat red triangular patch with rounded corners, stitched on, covering it completely. No eyes or skin can be seen. He wears a black roll-neck pulled up under the hood, a sharp charcoal suit and black leather gloves, so no skin shows anywhere. He stands perfectly still, gloved hands resting together in front of him. Behind him the wall screen glows a cold, empty blue. One soft key light from camera left; the screen's blue glow rims the white wool from behind. Medium close-up, eye level, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field so the screen goes soft. Saturated colour: the deep red patch, the cold blue screen, the white wool. Shot on 35mm film, fine grain. Thanks.
